name: Signal Foundry
description: Experiment with mysterious symbols to decode a hidden language.
features: 24 original English missions with specific hints and post-finish explanations
A deterministic eight-operation language with 1,680 possible stamp assignments
Experiment budgets, visible evidence notebooks and honest ambiguity assessment
Guest attempts with server checks and private browser recovery capabilities
Local challenge builder, author JSON backups and printable HTML play records
Explicit account-based publication, immutable share links and source-preserving forks
businessHypothesis: Public reasoning-game sessions and shared challenge pages may support display advertising after publisher approval and consent configuration. Return play and shared creations are measurable hypotheses; audience and revenue have not been established.
